mentions.name: Niblet - Weaning Diary
mentions.description: A weaning diary app for parents to log the food their baby eats and any reactions (such as rashes), helping them spot patterns to discuss with their GP. It also provides guidance on nutrients, food variety, and how to serve foods, all sourced from the NHS and FSA.
mentions.problem: During weaning, babies can develop reactions like rashes and it is hard to work out which foods are causing them, making it difficult to identify patterns before talking to a GP.
mentions.audience: Weaning parents of babies, who need to track foods and reactions to discuss with their GP
mentions.source_excerpt: So I created an app for weaning parents to log the food, add any reactions so when talking to their GP they can start to see a pattern and all advice, like nutrients, food variety, how to serve food all coming from the NHS and FSA.
mentions.author: MummyMahoney
